text:
sara: morning async — quick checkin:

sara: what I did: validated routing policy priority map for api-edge, tightened matchers for /v1/embeddings so canary traffic stays isolated
sara: blockers: intermittent 5xx on embeddings endpoint under burst load, haven't pinned downstream yet
sara: today: finalize rate-limiter rollout plan, open PR for fallback route that redirects to a lighter model

miguel: looking into the 5xxs — saw a pattern where backend timeout aligns with a KV cache eviction spike
miguel: ran a short load run, reproduces at ~220rps to the pool

miguel: k6 snippet I used:
```
k6 run --vus 60 --duration 45s embeddings-load.js
```

alex: pushed a small auth header normalization fix to canary (PR #2489) — should prevent mismatched routing for a subset of clients
alex: added `X-GW-Canary` on responses to help tracing

sara: thanks @alex — can you drop a changelog line and tag @diane for review?

diane: will review in ~20m. can we add a smoke assertion to the canary job: /v1/embeddings 99% success over 1m?
diane: infra side OK, but need explicit rollback threshold and notify list for paging if >2% errors for 5m

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for gateway-canary-1758509999
deploy-bot: Canary checks: health=passing, smoke=/v1/health ok, canary_traffic=2%

miguel: quick question — if we increase per-worker rate limit to 120r/s should batching be reduced? Optimize rec suggests max_batch_tokens -> 512 for embeddings under low-latency config
sara: agree, we'll update batching config in the same PR (RD-556) so rate and batch are consistent

diane: reminder to product: hold big-batch clients during the canary window, otherwise we may skew results

alex: merging auth fix after CI green :thumbsup:

miguel: watching metrics, will alert if 5xx > 1% in the next 10m and canary rollback if threshold crossed

sara: thanks team — I'll post a follow-up once we hit the 12:00 UTC checkpoint. if anyone spots anomalous traces, drop them here or ping oncall. :wave:
